title: Make2dView Command
description: Bake one Make2D view as visible HiddenLineDrawing curves on an S-* layer. Stamps forsk:kind=drawing, forsk:generated=1, forsk:view, forsk:level=0, and forsk:id d01…. Ids omitted gathers generated wall, floor, roof, and opening solids, plus existing underlay when include_existing is true. Skips opening markers, room markers, and previous drawings. Empty sources return count 0. replace deletes the previous pack for that view before bake.

view.description: Parallel view. plan looks -Z, north -Y, south +Y, east -X, west +X.

ids.description: Explicit source GUIDs. Omit to gather Forsk clay (and existing underlay when include_existing is true).

include_existing.description: Include X-EXIST / forsk:kind=existing in the silhouette when ids is omitted.

replace.description: Delete existing forsk:kind=drawing curves for this view (or on its S-* layer) before baking.
